profile.headline: Software Engineer at TruStage | B.S. Physics | B.S. Computer Science at CU Boulder 2027 | C# | .NET | Python | SQL
profile.summary:
I am a dynamic professional with a foundation in Computer Science and Physics, specializing in backend development, research innovation, and data analysis. My educational background includes a B.S. in Physics with a professional emphasis and a certificate in Software Development. I am currently continuing my education at the University of Colorado Boulder, pursuing a degree in Computer Science with an emphasis in Data Science and Machine Learning, further strengthening my foundation in analytical thinking, computational methods, and problem-solving.

Currently, at TruStage, I work as a Software Developer in a collaborative Agile/Scrum environment, specializing in C# and .NET backend development within the annuities and investment domain. I am committed to upholding industry best practices and ensuring the delivery of high-quality solutions through rigorous standards and procedures.

As I continue to grow professionally and academically, I am increasingly interested in the intersection of Physics and Computer Science, particularly Data Science. My long-term goals include pursuing advanced studies in Physics, contributing to scientific research, and exploring opportunities in computational physics, and particle physics. I am passionate about leveraging my technical background to solve complex problems, contribute to scientific innovation, and bridge the gap between software development and scientific discovery.

Industry Experience:
C#, JavaScript, Python, React, Node.js, Express, .NET, SQL, MongoDB, Agile Development

Areas of Academic and Research Interest:
Computational Physics, Particle Physics, Quantum Physics, Astrophysics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Scientific Computing, Research Innovation

Let’s connect! I am open to exploring potential collaborations and discussing the fascinating realms of physics, computer science, data science, and software development. Together, we can create and innovate for a brighter future.

Feel free to reach out to me directly on LinkedIn or at elliediaz1204@gmail.com.

Have a great day!

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Currently, I am an integral part of a dynamic team in an Agile Scrum environment, specializing in C# and .Net for backend development within the annuities and investment domain. I continue to collaborate with my team on the successful implementation and maintenance of features, contributing significantly to the ongoing enhancement of product functionality.

I actively leverage Azure DevOps, Yaml Pipelines, and Git for version control, facilitating streamlined collaboration and efficient code management across our projects.

In addition to my development responsibilities, I am proficient in providing on-call support and resolving issues promptly to ensure the continued availability and reliability of critical systems.

Committed to professional growth, I remain actively engaged in continuous learning and skill development, staying at the forefront of industry trends and emerging technologies to continually elevate our team's capabilities.
positions.insights: Software Development, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +3 skills

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description: During my time at Jen-Ter Technologies, I played a key role in product design, utilizing CAD models and drawings to both enhance existing products and conceptualize new ones. I maintained a steadfast commitment to the highest standards of quality throughout the entire project life cycle. This involved providing crucial engineering recommendations and guidance to project management members and craftspeople. My ability to consistently meet product design requirements within scheduled completion deadlines showcased my proficiency in both collaborative team environments and independent work.
positions.insights: Research and Development (R&D), Data Analysis and +10 skills

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Specialist
positions.description:
In my prior positions, I demonstrated innovation by creating a new product, conducting rigorous tests to ensure sustainability and uphold high-quality standards. This product played a crucial role in the organization's initial manufacturing venture. Proficient in troubleshooting, I addressed issues with diverse devices, showcasing adaptability and problem-solving skills.

Additionally, I contributed to cost-effectiveness by conducting experiments to assess materials, analyzing results, and determining optimal components. My role extended to providing material design specifications and resolving production-related challenges, emphasizing a proactive and hands-on approach to ensuring project success.
positions.insights: Research and Development (R&D), Data Analysis and +5 skills

projects.title: Where do you want to eat?
projects.description:
Collaborated with a team to develop an application that allows users to search for restaurants in their area and randomizes the results to choose one when prompted. This application displays real-time data using the google API but only after the user grants permission.

Technologies Used: HTML, CSS, Javascript, React.js, Express, Node.js, MongoDB, Google API
